8 9 --- 10 11 # goimports-reviser 12 13 ![logo](./images/reviser-muscot_200.png) 14 15 Tool for Golang to sort goimports by 3-4 groups: std, general, company (optional), and project dependencies. 16 Also formats your code (no need to use `gofmt` or `goimports` separately). 17 18 ## Features 19 20 - Sort imports into logical groups (stdlib, general, company, project) 21 - Remove unused imports with `-rm-unused` 22 - Set aliases for versioned packages with `-set-alias` 23 - Format code automatically with `-format` 24 - Apply to directories recursively 25 - Group company imports separately with `-company-prefixes` 26 27 ## Usage 28 29 ### Basic command: 30 ```bash 31 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format ./reviser/reviser.go 32 ``` 33 34 ### Apply to a directory recursively: 35 ```bash 36 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format -recursive reviser 37 ``` 38 39 ### Apply to all files: 40 ```bash 41 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format ./... 42 ``` 43 44 ### Apply to multiple targets: 45 ```bash 46 goimports-reviser -rm-unused -set-alias -format ./reviser/reviser.go ./pkg/... 47 ``` 48 49 ### Options: 50 ```text 51 Usage of goimports-reviser: 52 -apply-to-generated-files 53 Apply imports sorting and formatting(if the option is set) to generated files. Generated file is a file with first comment which starts with comment '// Code generated'. Optional parameter. 54 -company-prefixes string 55 Company package prefixes which will be placed after 3rd-party group by default(if defined). Values should be comma-separated. Optional parameters. 56 -excludes string 57 Exclude files or dirs, example: '.git/,proto/*.go'. 58 -file-path string 59 Deprecated. Put file name as an argument(last item) of command line. 60 -format 61 Option will perform additional formatting. Optional parameter. 62 -imports-order string 63 Your imports groups can be sorted in your way. 64 std - std import group; 65 general - libs for general purpose; 66 company - inter-org or your company libs(if you set '-company-prefixes'-option, then 4th group will be split separately. In other case, it will be the part of general purpose libs); 67 project - your local project dependencies; 68 blanked - imports with "_" alias; 69 dotted - imports with "." alias. 70 Optional parameter. (default "std,general,company,project") 71 -list-diff 72 Option will list files whose formatting differs from goimports-reviser. Optional parameter. 73 -local string 74 Deprecated 75 -output string 76 Can be "file", "write" or "stdout". Whether to write the formatted content back to the file or to stdout. When "write" together with "-list-diff" will list the file name and write back to the file. Optional parameter. (default "file") 77 -project-name string 78 Your project name(ex.: github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser). Optional parameter. 79 -recursive 80 Apply rules recursively if target is a directory. In case of ./... execution will be recursively applied by default. Optional parameter. 81 -rm-unused 82 Remove unused imports. Optional parameter. 83 -separate-named 84 Separate named imports from their group with a new line. Optional parameter. 85 -set-alias 86 Set alias for versioned package names, like 'github.com/go-pg/pg/v9'. In this case import will be set as 'pg "github.com/go-pg/pg/v9"'. Optional parameter. 87 -set-exit-status 88 set the exit status to 1 if a change is needed/made. Optional parameter. 89 -use-cache 90 Use cache to improve performance. Optional parameter. 91 -version 92 Show version. 93 ``` 94 95 ## Examples 96 97 ### Before usage: 98 ```go 99 package testdata 100 101 import ( 102 "log" 103 104 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/testdata/innderpkg" 105 106 "bytes" 107 108 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" 109 ) 110 ``` 111 112 ### After usage: 113 ```go 114 package testdata 115 116 import ( 117 "bytes" 118 "log" 119 120 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" 121 122 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/testdata/innderpkg" 123 ) 124 ``` 125 126 Comments for imports are preserved: 127 ```go 128 package testdata 129 130 import ( 131 "fmt" // comments to the package here 132 ) 133 ``` 134 135 ### Example with `-company-prefixes` option 136 137 Before: 138 ```go 139 package testdata // goimports-reviser/testdata 140 141 import ( 142 "fmt" //fmt package 143 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" //custom package 144 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/pkg" // this is a company package which is not a part of the project, but is a part of your organization 145 "goimports-reviser/pkg" 146 ) 147 ``` 148 149 After: 150 ```go 151 package testdata // goimports-reviser/testdata 152 153 import ( 154 "fmt" // fmt package 155 156 "golang.org/x/exp/slices" // custom package 157 158 "github.com/incu6us/goimports-reviser/pkg" // this is a company package which is not a part of the project, but is a part of your organization 159 160 "goimports-reviser/pkg" 161 ) 162 ``` 163 164 ### Example with `-imports-order std,general,company,project,blanked,dotted` option 165 166 Before: 167 ```go 168 package testdata // goimports-reviser/testdata 169 170 import ( 171 _ "github.com/pkg1" 172 . === cmp.sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: cmp.sh <srcfile>  -> prints baseline, -format, gofmt, gofmt -s and diffs
set -u
SRC="$1"; shift || true
D=/tmp/probe/format-flag/m
O=/tmp/probe/format-flag/out
cp "$SRC" "$D/a.go"
( cd "$D" && /workspace/executable -output stdout "$@" a.go > $O/c_base.out 2> $O/c_base.err; echo $? > $O/c_base.code )
cp "$SRC" "$D/a.go"
( cd "$D" && /workspace/executable -format -output stdout "$@" a.go > $O/c_fmt.out 2> $O/c_fmt.err; echo $? > $O/c_fmt.code )
cp "$SRC" "$D/a.go"
/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt "$D/a.go" > $O/c_gofmt.out 2> $O/c_gofmt.err; echo $? > $O/c_gofmt.code
/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt -s "$D/a.go" > $O/c_gofmts.out 2> $O/c_gofmts.err; echo $? > $O/c_gofmts.code
echo "=== SRC ($SRC) ==="; cat -A "$SRC"
echo "=== baseline exit=$(cat $O/c_base.code) ==="; cat -A $O/c_base.out
echo "--- baseline stderr ---"; cat $O/c_base.err
echo "=== -format exit=$(cat $O/c_fmt.code) ==="; cat -A $O/c_fmt.out
echo "--- -format stderr ---"; cat $O/c_fmt.err
echo "=== diff baseline vs -format ==="; diff $O/c_base.out $O/c_fmt.out
echo "=== diff gofmt vs baseline ==="; diff $O/c_gofmt.out $O/c_base.out
echo "=== diff gofmt vs -format ==="; diff $O/c_gofmt.out $O/c_fmt.out
echo "=== diff gofmt-s vs -format ==="; diff $O/c_gofmts.out $O/c_fmt.out
=== run.sh
#!/bin/bash
# usage: run.sh <testname> <src-file-content-path> [flags...]
# runs binary in /tmp/probe/format-flag/m with a.go = content
set -u
NAME="$1"; SRC="$2"; shift 2
D=/tmp/probe/format-flag/m
cp "$SRC" "$D/a.go"
cd "$D"
/workspace/executable "$@" a.go > /tmp/probe/format-flag/out/$NAME.out 2> /tmp/probe/format-flag/out/$NAME.err
echo "exit=$?" > /tmp/probe/format-flag/out/$NAME.code
cp "$D/a.go" /tmp/probe/format-flag/out/$NAME.file
=== modelcmp.sh
#!/bin/bash
D=/tmp/probe/format-flag/m
O=/tmp/probe/format-flag/out
M=/tmp/probe/format-flag/model/model
pass=0; fail=0
for f in /tmp/probe/format-flag/src/*.go; do
  n=$(basename $f)
  cp "$f" "$D/a.go"
  ( cd "$D" && /workspace/executable -output stdout a.go > $O/mb.out 2>/dev/null )
  cp "$f" "$D/a.go"
  ( cd "$D" && /workspace/executable -format -output stdout a.go > $O/mf.out 2>/dev/null )
  $M "$f" > $O/mm_base.out 2>/dev/null
  $M "$f" format > $O/mm_fmt.out 2>/dev/null
  r1=OK; r2=OK
  cmp -s $O/mb.out $O/mm_base.out || r1=DIFF
  cmp -s $O/mf.out $O/mm_fmt.out || r2=DIFF
  printf '%-24s base=%-5s format=%-5s\n' "$n" "$r1" "$r2"
  if [ "$r1$r2" = "OKOK" ]; then pass=$((pass+1)); else fail=$((fail+1)); fi
done
echo "pass=$pass fail=$fail"

#!/bin/bash
# T.sh <case-file> [extra flags...] : runs baseline vs -format vs gofmt vs gofmt -s
set -u
SRC="$1"; shift || true
W=/tmp/probe/format-flag/w
R=/tmp/probe/format-flag/res
N=$(basename "$SRC" .go)
cp "$SRC" "$W/a.go"
( cd "$W" && /workspace/executable -output stdout "$@" a.go > "$R/$N.base.out" 2> "$R/$N.base.err"; echo $? > "$R/$N.base.code" )
cp "$SRC" "$W/a.go"
( cd "$W" && /workspace/executable -format -output stdout "$@" a.go > "$R/$N.fmt.out" 2> "$R/$N.fmt.err"; echo $? > "$R/$N.fmt.code" )
cp "$SRC" "$W/a.go"
/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt   "$W/a.go" > "$R/$N.gofmt.out"  2> "$R/$N.gofmt.err";  echo $? > "$R/$N.gofmt.code"
/usr/local/go/bin/gofmt -s "$W/a.go" > "$R/$N.gofmts.out" 2> "$R/$N.gofmts.err"; echo $? > "$R/$N.gofmts.code"
echo "########## CASE $N"
echo "--- SRC"; cat -A "$SRC"
echo "--- BASELINE (exit $(cat $R/$N.base.code))"; cat -A "$R/$N.base.out"; echo "  stderr:"; cat "$R/$N.base.err"
echo "--- FORMAT (exit $(cat $R/$N.fmt.code))"; cat -A "$R/$N.fmt.out"; echo "  stderr:"; cat "$R/$N.fmt.err"
echo "--- DIFF base -> format"; diff "$R/$N.base.out" "$R/$N.fmt.out" && echo "   (identical)"
echo "--- DIFF gofmt -> format"; diff "$R/$N.gofmt.out" "$R/$N.fmt.out" && echo "   (identical)"
echo "--- DIFF gofmt-s -> format"; diff "$R/$N.gofmts.out" "$R/$N.fmt.out" && echo "   (identical)"
echo "--- DIFF gofmt -> base"; diff "$R/$N.gofmt.out" "$R/$N.base.out" && echo "   (identical)"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/probe/format-flag/T.sh && echo ok
